name: hero
prompt: Create a production SOURCE SPRITE ATLAS for the children's game "Car Runaway". ONE SQUARE image exactly 1024 x 1024 pixels, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells, 16 isolated sprites. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. No ground shadows, no ambient background, no cell borders, no text, no labels, no title, no numbers. Each sprite fully inside its own cell with generous clear padding, never touches another cell. Strict tidy regular grid. Cohesive original colorful retro 2D pixel art with clearly visible clean pixel clusters, warm dark brown outlines, restrained 16-bit handheld adventure palette, not a voxel render, not photorealistic, not vector. These must be usable small game sprites. SUBJECT: consistent cute ginger KITTEN, cream muzzle, cream paws, green eyes, a few dark orange stripes, four-legged ANIMAL, no clothes, no accessories. Each pose approximately 130 pixels tall within 256px cell, same character scale, aligned same foot baseline in each row. ROW 1 top-down RPG view FACING DOWN toward viewer, four genuine walking cycle phases: left forepaw forward, passing, right forepaw forward, passing. ROW 2 top-down RPG view FACING UP away from viewer, same four walking phases, back of head visible no face. ROW 3 strict SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT, four genuine walking phases with different leg placements, cat body horizontal, four legs, tail. ROW 4 strict SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT, four jump states: crouched anticipation; upward stretched takeoff; airborne with legs tucked; landing crouch. Maintain exact kitten identity throughout. This sheet is for a maze seen from above plus a side-view platformer. Left direction will be mirrored from right.
